{{#ifeq:{{{game|}}}|II|''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''|''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''}} {{#if:{{{USE|}}}|&mdash; ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition|Ultimate Sith Edition]]''}}{{#if:{{{version|}}}|&#32;<small>({{{version}}} versions only)</small>}}{{#if:{{{notes|}}}|&#32;<small>({{{notes}}})</small>}}<noinclude>

==Usage==
*For ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>TFU|USE=y|version=|notes=}}

*For ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''
<nowiki>{{</nowiki>TFU|game=II|version=|notes=}}

Use this template whenever appearances from ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' or ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' require addition notes beyond the basic game version. Add "game=II" for the video game sequel. Add "y" or "1" to the "USE' field to add "&mdash; ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition|Ultimate Sith Edition]]''" for the original game's expansion. For the "version" field, adding "X-box, PS3 and PC" will result in {{C|X-box, PS3 and PC versions only}}, use it to indicate when the subject only appears in certain versions on either game. You can also use "Notes" field to indicate whenever a character only appears as a playable costume or is only available through a cheat code, appears only in a downloadable level, or other notes.

Remove unused optional fields.

==Examples==
<pre>*{{TFU|game=II|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]]|notes="[[Mynock/Legends|Mynock]]" databank entry}}</pre> creates:

*{{TFU|game=II|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]]|notes="[[Mynock/Legends|Mynock]]" databank entry}}
